description: Land Acquisition - Divithotawela, Welimada D/S Division, Badulla District and Walakanda, Kirinda-Puhulwella D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. The content details specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including descriptions of the land, lot numbers, extents, and claimant information. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions.
